questions.question: Match the following Group command with their functions. Group Command Functions 1. Insert Caption I. Appear at the end of the page. 2. Insert Footnote II. Smart Lookup. 3. Research III. Function to add a citation and allows to update the table. 4. Table of Authorities IV. Allows you to insert Cross-reference into your document.
questions.questionHtml:
Match the following Group command with their functions.

Group Command Functions

1. Insert Caption

 I. Appear at the end of the page.
2. Insert Footnote II. Smart Lookup.
3. Research III. Function to add a citation and allows to update the table.
4. Table of Authorities  IV. Allows you to insert Cross-reference into your document.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1.IV 2. I 3.II 4.III.

Important Points

  • Reference tab contains resources for researchers and anyone in the professional field.
  • We can add a footnote to our document from the References tab.
  • The References Tab allows to create a table of contents, footnotes, citations, cross‐references, select MLA or APA or ISO formats.  
  • We can also turn your Works Cited into a collection of records and use them in the future.

​

 

Key Points

The table below shows the description of each group and button in the reference tab.

Group/Button Description
Table of Content
  • To add a table of contents to a document, click this button.
  • A gallery of three different types of tables will display. The
  • automatic tables use the Heading 1 to 3 styles to create the table.
  • Click the Custom Table of Contents link to display additional options for creating a Table of Contents.
Add Text 
  • Click this button to include the current heading in the table

of contents.
Update Table
  • This button is used to update the page numbers or the entire table of contents.
Insert Footnote
  • To create a footnote within a document, click this button.
  • A footnote will appear at the end of the page.
Insert Endnote
  • This button is used to insert an endnote into the document.
  • Endnotes usually appear at the end of the document.
Show Notes
  • This button is used to scroll through a document to find

           the location for the footnotes and endnotes.
Insert Citation
  • To cite a book, journal article, or other article as a source for information used in a document, click this button.
  • The citation can be created from the selected text or can be typed into the document.
  • The citation will be formatted according to the style selected.
Manage Sources
  • Click this button to view a list of all the citations in the
          document.
Bibliography
  • To add a bibliography (list of all the sources) into a
          the document, click this button.

 

Insert Caption
  • Click this button to insert a caption for a picture or other

          image, a shape, or a table.

  • The Caption Dialog Box will display where several options for creating the caption are provided.
Insert Table of Figures
  • To insert a table (list) of all the figures in the document, click this button.
  • The Table of Figures Dialog Box will display. This is where the criteria for the table can be specified.
Update Table
  • Click this button to update the table of figures so that all the figures are included in the list.
Cross-reference
  • This button is used to insert a cross-reference to headings, a figure, or a table within a document.
  • By default, crossreferences are inserted as hyperlinks.
Table of Authorities
  • Adds the currently selected text so it will appear in the table of authority.
  • Inserts a table of authorities for cases, statutes and other authorities in the document.
  • Updates the table of authorities to include all the citations in the document.

questions.question: Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct? (i) Animations can only be applied to selected Slides objects in an MS-Powerpoint presentation. (ii) 'Slide Sorter' appears under 'View' tab in MS-Powerpoint 2016.
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

(i) Animations can only be applied to selected Slides objects in an MS-Powerpoint presentation.

(ii) 'Slide Sorter' appears under 'View' tab in MS-Powerpoint 2016.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Both (i) and (ii).

Key Points

  • The PowerPoint has unique features like animation, slide shows and so on.
  • Animations can only be applied to selected Slides objects in an MS-Powerpoint presentation.
  • 'Slide Sorter' appears under the 'View' tab in MS Powerpoint 2016.

Thus the correct answer is ​Both (i) and (ii).

Additional Information

  • The main creators of MS PowerPoint software are Robert Gaskins and Dennis Austin, launched in 1987. PowerPoint Presentation area is useful for every person and practised usage. Given below area unit one or two of the foremost fields where PPT is extremely useful:
    • Education – With e-learning and smart classes being chosen as a typical mode of education lately, PowerPoint displays can facilitate making education loads interactive and attract students towards the modified version of learning.
    • Marketing – Among the sphere of commerce, PowerPoint displays are going to be terribly necessary. Practice graphs and charts, numbers are going to be shown loads plain and clearly which may be ignored by the viewer if being scanned.
    • Business – To raise investors or to point out the increase or decrease in profits, MS PowerPoint is going to be used.
    • Depicting Growth – Since every graphic and text is going to be adscititious throughout a presentation, the portrayal of the enlargement of an organization, business, student’s marks, etc. is easier than practice PPT.

questions.question: Identify which of the following statements are true or false: i) In MS-Word 365, you can use the 'Track Changes' feature to keep track of edits made to a document. ii) The 'Track Changes' feature is found under the 'Review' tab.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify which of the following statements are true or false:

i) In MS-Word 365, you can use the 'Track Changes' feature to keep track of edits made to a document.

ii) The 'Track Changes' feature is found under the 'Review' tab.
questions.solution: In MS-Word 365, the 'Track Changes' feature allows users to monitor edits made to a document, ensuring transparency and ease of review. This feature is conveniently located under the 'Review' tab, making it accessible for users to enable or disable as needed.

questions.question: In Excel, which function is used to verify if a specific data value is entered in a cell?
questions.questionHtml: In Excel, which function is used to verify if a specific data value is entered in a cell?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 3) COUNTIF()

Key Points

Why?
  • COUNTIF() checks whether a specific data value appears in a cell or range by counting matches. If the count ≥ 1, the value is present.
Option-wise Explanation
  • 1) MATCH() → Returns the position of a value in a range; it doesn’t directly verify presence as TRUE/FALSE.
  • 2) ISBLANK() → Only checks if a cell is empty. It does not test for a specific value.
  • 3) COUNTIF() → Correct. Counts cells meeting a criterion (i.e., a specific value).
  • 4) ISNUMBER() → Checks if the content is numeric, not whether it equals a particular value.
Quick Examples

Check if "Apple" is in A1:A10:

=COUNTIF(A1:A10,"Apple")>0

Check if A1 equals "Apple":

=COUNTIF(A1,"Apple")>0

questions.question: Identify whether the following statements are true or false: i) In MS-Word 365, the 'Page Layout' tab allows you to change the orientation of the document. ii) In MS-Word 365, you can apply 'Track Changes' to keep track of edits made to a document. iii) In MS-Word 365, 'Track Changes' can only be used in the 'Review' tab.
questions.questionHtml:
Identify whether the following statements are true or false:

i) In MS-Word 365, the 'Page Layout' tab allows you to change the orientation of the document.

ii) In MS-Word 365, you can apply 'Track Changes' to keep track of edits made to a document.

iii) In MS-Word 365, 'Track Changes' can only be used in the 'Review' tab.

options.text: i - True, ii - True, iii - True
options.html: i - True, ii - True, iii - True

options.text: i - True, ii - False, iii - True
options.html: i - True, ii - False, iii - True

options.text: i - False, ii - True, iii - False
options.html: i - False, ii - True, iii - False

options.text: i - True, ii - True, iii - False
options.html: i - True, ii - True, iii - False

questions.solution: In MS-Word 365, the 'Page Layout' tab indeed allows you to change the orientation of the document. 'Track Changes' can be applied to keep track of edits, but it is available only in the 'Review' tab. Therefore, statements i and ii are true, while statement iii is false.

questions.question: The 'Ctrl + W' keyboard shortcut is used for which of the following purposes in MS-Word 365?
questions.questionHtml: The 'Ctrl + W' keyboard shortcut is used for which of the following purposes in MS-Word 365?

options.text: To cut the selected content to the Clipboard and paste the contents of the Clipboard
options.html: To cut the selected content to the Clipboard and paste the contents of the Clipboard

options.text: To copy the selected content to the Clipboard
options.html: To copy the selected content to the Clipboard

options.text: To paste the contents of the Clipboard
options.html: To paste the contents of the Clipboard

questions.solution: In MS-Word 365, the 'Ctrl + W' keyboard shortcut is used to close the currently open document. This command helps users quickly exit a document without using the mouse or navigating through menus. It does not affect the content on the Clipboard.

questions.question: What does the VLOOKUP function do in Excel?
questions.questionHtml: What does the VLOOKUP function do in Excel?

options.text: It looks vertically down the first column of a range for a key and returns the value of a specified cell in the row found
options.html: It looks vertically down the first column of a range for a key and returns the value of a specified cell in the row found

options.text: It calculates the average of a range of cells
options.html: It calculates the average of a range of cells

options.text: It replaces specific text in a text string
options.html: It replaces specific text in a text string

options.text: It divides the contents of one cell from another
options.html: It divides the contents of one cell from another

questions.solution: The VLOOKUP function in Excel searches for a specified key in the first column of a range and returns the value from a cell in the same row but a different column. This is useful for looking up and retrieving data from large tables efficiently.

questions.question: In MS Word 365, what happens when you select text and then press the ‘Backspace’ key?
questions.questionHtml: In MS Word 365, what happens when you select text and then press the ‘Backspace’ key?

options.text: The text is moved to the end of the document
options.html: The text is moved to the end of the document

options.text: The text is formatted with a bold style
options.html: The text is formatted with a bold style

options.text: The text is copied to the clipboard
options.html: The text is copied to the clipboard

options.text: The text is deleted to the left of the cursor
options.html: The text is deleted to the left of the cursor

questions.solution:
The correct answer is The text is deleted to the left of the cursorKey Points

  •  When you select text in MS Word 365 and press the Backspace key, the selected text is deleted from the document.
  • The deletion removes the selected text entirely, regardless of its position relative to the cursor, as the selection takes precedence.
  • Each time you press and release the Backspace key, the insertion point moves back one space and the character occupying that space is deleted.
  • You can also select text in Word by using the keyboard or mouse.
  • For example, you can select all text in a document by pressing Ctrl+A. 

Additional Information

  • The text is moved to the end of the document: Pressing Backspace does not move text; it deletes it.
  • Text can only be moved by cut-and-paste or drag-and-drop actions.
  • The text is formatted with a bold style: Bold formatting is applied using Ctrl + B, not the Backspace key.
  • The text is copied to the clipboard: Copying requires Ctrl + C, not the Backspace key.
  • Backspace does not copy text.

questions.question: Consider the following screen parts of MS Word 2019 - I: Quick Access Toolbar II: Document Tab III: File tab on the Ribbon IV: Status bar Which of the above offers the save, undo and repeat options?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following screen parts of MS Word 2019 -

I: Quick Access Toolbar

II: Document Tab

III: File tab on the Ribbon

IV: Status bar

Which of the above offers the save, undo and repeat options?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is I and III.

  • Following offers the save, undo and repeat options:
    • Quick Access Toolbar
    • File tab on the Ribbon

Key Points

  • The Quick Access Toolbar holds a few buttons for commands that you'll use often, such as save, undo, redo, and repeat.

questions.question: The term gutter margin in MS-Word indicates ____________.
questions.questionHtml: The term gutter margin in MS-Word indicates ____________.

options.text: adding margin to adjust text wrap
options.html: adding margin to adjust text wrap

options.text: adding margins to adjust text wrap and right margins
options.html: adding margins to adjust text wrap and right margins

options.text: adding margin to right adjust text
options.html: adding margin to right adjust text

options.text: adding margins to the bordering sides
options.html: adding margins to the bordering sides

questions.solution:
The correct answer is adding margins to the bordering sides.

Key Points

  • Gutter margin is a margin that is added to the binding side of a document. This is important for documents that are bound, as it ensures that text is not obscured by the binding.
  • In MS-Word, you can set the gutter margin along with the normal margins to ensure that the text is properly visible and not hidden by the binding.
  • The gutter margin is typically used in documents like books, reports, or any other printed material that will be bound.

Additional Information

  • Option 1: Adding margin to adjust text wrap - This is incorrect as text wrap does not directly relate to gutter margins.
  • Option 2: Adding margins to adjust text wrap and right margins - This is incorrect as it confuses the purpose of gutter margins with general margin adjustments.
  • Option 3: Adding margin to right adjust text - This is incorrect as gutter margins are specifically for the binding side, not just the right side.
